why: The commentary argues that schema-per-tenant has a restore/delete advantage and warns that the chosen approach requires additional tooling.
span: Schema-per-tenant gets tenant-level restore/delete almost for free (restore one schema). Shared schema doesn't — you'll need to build actual tooling (scoped export/restore or soft-delete-and-purge logic keyed on tenant_id) to restore or delete a single tenant's data without touching others.
